I've completed the web search for Arable Labs. Here's a summary of the findings:

## Arable Labs Overview

Arable Labs Inc. is a developer of an integrated system for agriculture that helps digitize and optimize decisions from seed breeding to food production.

## Products

The Arable Mark 3 is designed to help reach the full potential of digital agriculture and is more innovative, reliable, and robust than previous versions. It's a lightweight and portable IoT sensing device that sets up in minutes and requires zero maintenance. The device captures weather, plant, soil, and irrigation data, along with crop images in a single easy-to-use, no-maintenance device.

## Technology

The platform measures everything that matters to the crop, from the weather to the soil, to the plant itself by the use of a unique set of spectral and thermal sensors.

## Customers

Forward-thinking agribusinesses, farming operations, and food and beverage companies use Arable to be more productive, sustainable, and profitable. Arable is currently employed by some of the world's leading farming enterprises, providers of agricultural inputs, food and beverage companies and research organizations.

## Applications

Arable helps customers around the globe optimize water use, crop protection, fertilization, field work, research trials, food supply chains, and sustainability initiatives.
